subject: mathematics
content: Let $[\cdot]$ denote the greatest integer function and $f(x) = \lim\limits_{n \to \infty} \frac{1}{n^{3}} \sum\limits_{k=1}^n \left[ \frac{k^2}{3^x} \right]$. Then $12 \sum\limits_{j=1}^{\infty} f(i)$ is equal to ________.
